description_en: Queries the attributes of an endpoint service that belongs to the current account
description_zh: 调用GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute接口，查询归属当前账号的终端节点服务属性信息
kebab_example: aliyun privatelink get-vpc-endpoint-service-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --service-id epsrv-hp3vpx8yqxblby3i0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVpcEndpointServiceAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the endpoint service.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
终端节点服务所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120468.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint service
parameters.name: service_id

AddressIpVersion.description_en:
The protocol version. Valid values:

IPv4: IPv4.
DualStack: dual-stack
AddressIpVersion.description_zh:
协议版本。取值：

IPv4：IPv4类型。
DualStack：双栈类型

AutoAcceptEnabled.description_en:
Specifies whether to automatically accept endpoint connections. Valid values:

true: automatically accept endpoint connections.

false: do not automatically accept endpoint connections
AutoAcceptEnabled.description_zh:
是否自动接受终端节点连接，取值：

true：自动接受终端节点连接。

false：不自动接受终端节点连接

ConnectBandwidth.description_en: The default bandwidth limit of the endpoint connection. Unit: Mbps. Valid values: 100 to 10240
ConnectBandwidth.description_zh: 默认连接带宽峰值。单位：Mbps。取值范围：100~10240

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the endpoint service was created
CreateTime.description_zh: 终端节点服务的创建时间

MaxBandwidth.description_en: The maximum bandwidth of the endpoint connection. Unit: Mbps
MaxBandwidth.description_zh: 终端节点连接的最大带宽。单位：Mbps

MinBandwidth.description_en: The minimum bandwidth of the endpoint connection. Unit: Mbps
MinBandwidth.description_zh: 终端节点连接的最小带宽。单位：Mbps

Payer.description_en:
The payer. Valid values:

Endpoint: the service consumer.
EndpointService: the service provider
Payer.description_zh:
付费方，取值：

Endpoint：服务使用方。
EndpointService：服务提供方

RegionId.description_en: The region to which the endpoint service belongs
RegionId.description_zh: 终端节点服务所属的地域

ServiceBusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the endpoint service. Valid values:

Normal: normal.

FinancialLocked: financial lock
ServiceBusinessStatus.description_zh:
终端节点服务的业务状态，取值：

Normal：正常。

FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

ServiceDescription.description_en: The description of the endpoint service
ServiceDescription.description_zh: 终端节点服务的描述信息

ServiceDomain.description_en: The service domain name of the endpoint service
ServiceDomain.description_zh: 终端节点服务的服务域名

ServiceId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint service

ServiceName.description_en: The name of the endpoint service

ServiceResourceType.description_en:
The EPS resource type. Valid values:

slb: the EPS resource type is Classic Load Balancer (CLB).
alb: the EPS resource type is Application Load Balancer (ALB).
nlb: the EPS resource type is Network Load Balancer (NLB).
gwlb: the EPS resource type is Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB)
ServiceResourceType.description_zh:
服务资源类型，取值：

slb：表示服务资源类型为传统型负载均衡CLB（Classic Load Balancer）。
alb：表示服务资源类型为应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）。
nlb ：表示服务资源类型为网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer ）。
gwlb : 表示服务资源类型为网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）

ServiceStatus.description_en:
The status of the endpoint service. Valid values:

Creating: being created.

Pending: being modified.

Active: available.

Deleting: being deleted
ServiceStatus.description_zh:
终端节点服务的状态，取值：

Creating：创建中。

Pending：修改中。

Active：可用。

Deleting：删除中

ServiceSupportIPv6.description_en:
Indicates whether IPv6 is supported for the endpoint service. Valid values:

true: IPv6 is supported.
false (default): IPv6 is not supported
ServiceSupportIPv6.description_zh:
终端节点服务是否支持IPv6功能。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否

ServiceType.description_en:
The endpoint type.

Interface: an interface endpoint. You can add Classic Load Balancer (CLB), Application Load Balancer (ALB), and Network Load Balancer (NLB) instances as service resources.
GatewayLoadBalancer: a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint (GWLBe). You can add Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instances as service resources
ServiceType.description_zh:
终端节点类型。

Interface：表示接口终端节点，您可以添加传统型负载均衡CLB（Classic Load Balancer）、应用型负载均衡ALB（Application Load Balancer）和网络型负载均衡NLB（Network Load Balancer ）的服务资源类型。
GatewayLoadBalancer： 表示网关型负载均衡终端节点，您可以添加网关型负载均衡 GWLB（Gateway Load Balancer）作为服务资源

SupportedRegionSet.description_en: The list of regions supported by the endpoint service. Service consumers can initiate endpoint connections from the regions in this list
SupportedRegionSet.description_zh: 终端节点服务支持的地域列表，服务使用方可从列表中的地域发起终端节点连接

RegionBusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the region supported by the endpoint service. Valid values:

Normal: normal.
FinancialLocked: financial lock
RegionBusinessStatus.description_zh:
终端节点服务支持的地域的业务状态。取值：

Normal：正常。
FinancialLocked：欠费锁定

RegionServiceStatus.description_en:
The status of the region supported by the endpoint service. Valid values:

Pending: being modified.
Available: available.
Deleting: being deleted.
Failed: failed.
Closed: closed
RegionServiceStatus.description_zh:
终端节点服务支持的地域的状态。取值：

Pending：变更中。
Available：可用。
Deleting：删除中。
Failed：失败。
Closed：关闭

SupportedRegionId.description_en: The ID of the region supported by the endpoint service
SupportedRegionId.description_zh: 终端节点服务支持的地域 ID

ZoneAffinityEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether zone affinity is enabled for the endpoint domain name of the connected service. Valid values:

true (default): Zone affinity is enabled.
false: Zone affinity is disabled
ZoneAffinityEnabled.description_zh:
是否支持连接服务的终端节点域名就近解析。取值：

true（默认值）：是。
false：否

Zones.description_en: The list of zones in which the service resources reside
Zones.description_zh: 服务资源所属的可用区列表

items.description_en: The zone in which the service resources reside
items.description_zh: 服务资源所属的可用区
